script_text: Aries, Mars ignites a dramatic power struggle over money and love this week ahead. Monday through Wednesday, Mars in your 7th House squares Jupiter in your 10th House, making Wednesday tense for partnerships and career decisions. Your Fire element urges bold action, but avoid impulsive spending completely under this square's pressure today. Thursday is the turning point as Venus enters your 5th House in trine to Saturn. Friday through Sunday, the Moon in your 1st House opposes Uranus in your 2nd House, bringing sudden money news and restless energy. Saturday favors a passionate love conversation, while Mercury sextile Mars in your 8th House helps negotiate a financial raise successfully. Friday is your power day because Venus trines Saturn in romance. Wednesday is your worst day because Mars squares Jupiter in your 10th House. Delay purchases until Friday, then act decisively today. Follow for daily updates.
